description_full: California First Leasing Corporation engages in the provision of loans and lease financing for universities, businesses, other commercial, healthcare, and government. The company was formerly known as California First National Bancorp and changed its name to California First Leasing Corporation in February 2021. California First Leasing Corporation was founded in 1977 and is headquartered in Newport Beach, California.
ceo_bio: Mr. Patrick E. Paddon | Founder, Chairman, President & CEO | Age 74 | Compensation: $191,263 (FY2025)
financial_summary: California First Leasing Corpor is a micro-cap financial services business with a $256M market cap on $29M of annual revenue.
The top line has compounded at +10% over the past three years, a respectable pace for a business of this size.
Returns on capital run at 8% against a 10% cost of capital, which means the business is destroying value with every dollar it reinvests.
On the balance sheet, the balance sheet carries net cash, which is the gold standard: the business never has to make desperate decisions in a bad year.

Shareholder yield is only 1.8%, a thin return of capital, and insiders hold 93% of the shares, so management thinks like owners because it is one — the strongest alignment there is, and within its sector the business captures 2.5× its fair share of profits, a structural advantage visible in the numbers.
